candidates: When a class is introduced or retained as a transitional/legacy shim pending future removal, do not merely note 'may change or be removed' in the docstring — add an unambiguous deprecation signal such as a `.. deprecated::` RST directive in the docstring (with the planned replacement path) or emit a `DeprecationWarning` at instantiation. Vague hedges do not give downstream users enough signal to act on.

After extracting superclasses or reshuffling code across an inheritance hierarchy, verify that no over-indentation or under-indentation was introduced in method signatures, parameter lists, or method bodies — such formatting errors are easy to introduce during copy/move refactors and should be caught before merge.
